collection.description: An older farmer shows a child how to judge ripe fruit.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an older farmer, shows a child how to judge ripe fruit. The elder admits the technique took years to master.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an older farmer, shows a child how to judge ripe fruit. A small mistake becomes a reason to try again, not a scolding.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an older farmer, shows a child how to judge ripe fruit. The lesson lasts longer than planned because neither wants to stop.

e4.text: (Name1), an older farmer, shows a child how to judge ripe fruit. The learner asks to see the movement one more time.
